plugins.name: monta
plugins.description: Operate EV charging infrastructure through the Monta API. Connects Claude to Monta's hosted MCP server so you can list sites and charge points, inspect charges and their cost breakdowns, pull charger and utilisation reports, investigate failed or stuck sessions, and manage teams, price groups, and webhooks. Requires Monta API credentials (Client ID and Client Secret) created in Monta Hub. Run /monta:setup after installing.

skills.name: monta-api
skills.description: Core knowledge for working with the Monta API through the Monta MCP tools. Use whenever the user asks about Monta, EV charge points, chargers, charging sessions, sites, teams, wallets, price groups, charge auth tokens, or webhooks, or when calling any get-*, post-*, patch-*, put-*, or delete-* Monta tool. Covers the domain model, auth and scopes, pagination, dates, rate limits, and which operations need confirmation.
skills.description_zh: 提供通过 Monta MCP 使用 API 的核心知识，涵盖电动汽车充电点、会话、站点、团队、钱包、价格组、认证令牌及 webhook，以及领域模型、认证范围、分页、日期、速率限制和需确认的操作。

skills.name: monta-charging-operations
skills.description: Step-by-step workflows for EV charging operators using Monta. Use when the user wants to investigate a failed, stuck, or zero-kWh charge, check why a charger is offline or in error, pull site or charger utilisation, reconcile charges against wallet transactions or invoices, or onboard a new site or charge point. Builds on the monta-api skill.
headings: Investigate a failed or stuck charge
Onboard a new site or charge point
skills.description_zh: 为 Monta 充电运营提供逐步流程，调查失败、卡住或零电量充电、离线及错误充电桩，分析站点利用率，将充电与钱包交易或发票对账，并接入新站点或充电点；依赖 monta-api。

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Connect Claude to the Monta API and verify the connection. Use when the user installs the Monta plugin, runs /monta:setup, asks how to get Monta API credentials, or when Monta tools are missing, return 401 or 403, or the connection looks broken.
headings: Branch: Missing scope or team restriction (403)
Rate limits and other common failures
skills.description_zh: 连接 Claude 与 Monta API 并验证连接，指导获取 API 凭据，处理工具缺失、401/403 或连接异常，用于安装插件及 monta:setup。

commands.name: charge-point
commands.description: Deep dive on one Monta charge point: status, connectors, recent charges, statistics, and logs

commands.name: charge-points
commands.description: List Monta charge points with their current state, optionally filtered by site, team, or state

commands.description: Pull the Monta charger report (sessions and kWh per charge point) for a team and period and summarise it

commands.name: charges
commands.description: Show recent Monta charging sessions for a period with a summary of energy, revenue, and failures

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show what the Monta plugin can do, grouped by area, with example prompts

commands.name: sites
commands.description: List Monta sites with charge point counts and availability

commands.name: teams
commands.description: List Monta teams with type, currency, frozen state, and site or charge point counts

commands.name: wallet
commands.description: Show a Monta team's wallets, balances, and recent wallet transactions

commands.name: webhooks
commands.description: Show the Monta webhook configuration and recent deliveries, including failures
